source='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    m = len(grid[0])
    assert n == m
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(n):
            if grid[r][c] != 2:
                continue
            orbit = {
                (r, c), (n - 1 - r, c), (r, n - 1 - c),
                (n - 1 - r, n - 1 - c), (c, r),
                (n - 1 - c, r), (c, n - 1 - r),
                (n - 1 - c, n - 1 - r),
            }
            values = {grid[a][b] for a, b in orbit if grid[a][b] != 2}
            assert len(values) == 1
            out[r][c] = values.pop()
    return out
'''
